text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Agriculture minister Edith Nawakwi warned traders in maize meal against raising prices. He said the government had enough stocks to flood the market to force prices down if they insisted on raising them.
- Backbenchers in parliamant said the agricultural marketing system was a disaster and warned that unless it was reviewed the farming sector would collapse.
- Magistrates and court justices in Lusaka have gone on strike to push for pay increases.
- Members of Parliament heckled female opposition member Inonge Mbikusita-Lewanika for proposing that government pass a law making polygamy illegal.
